messages:
acme-apiops: getting rapid 429s from dedicated pool quiet-pool-eu-west-1 after a plan migration at ~2026-03-17T12:45Z. tenant=tenant-acme-42. Payload shows rate_limit_exceeded and a unit mismatch.
jen.s (Support): sorry about that — can you paste the error payload and which endpoints are failing?
acme-apiops: payload:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "details": "tenant:tenant-acme-42 limit: 3600 unit: HOUR used: 3650"
}
```
Request IDs: r-0a1b2c3d r-4e5f6g7h. Affects text.generate and embeddings.
miguel (Infra): heads-up: dedicated enforcement expects requests/min. If the migration left the quota as 3600/hour we must convert to per-minute. Could be a denom translation bug.
lina (SRE): which migration job id? which pool?
acme-apiops: planflip-20260317-001 on quiet-pool-eu-west-1 via UI ~12:40Z. simple repro:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-2-large","input":"hi"}'
```
works a few times then 429.
jen.s (Support): we can either temp override quota or patch infra. Need immediate restoration?
acme-apiops: temp override please.
miguel (Infra): checked migration logs: transformer emitted limit_value=3600 and limit_unit=HOUR. Enforcement table treats allocated quota as if denom_unit=MINUTE -> math mismatch resulted in over-throttling (treated as 3600 rpm instead of 60 rpm).
lina (SRE): DB view:
```
rate_profiles: {profile_id: rp-9001, limit_value: "3600", limit_unit: "HOUR", applied_pool: "quiet-pool-eu-west-1"}
enforcement: {denom_unit: "MINUTE"}
```
Mismatch confirmed.
autoscale-bot: [info] quiet-pool-eu-west-1 autoscale +2 nodes at 12:52Z due to CPU; note: autoscale does not lift per-tenant throttles.
miguel (Infra): pushing hotfix to migration-transformer to normalize HOUR->MINUTE for dedicated pools. Will smoke on staging then prod.
jen.s (Support): applying temporary override: tenant-acme-42 quota set to 360000/min for 1 hour (emergency bypass). Will coordinate billing for credits.
acme-apiops: confirmed errors stopped immediately. thanks.
lina (SRE): long-term: deploy transformer hotfix, add schema validation to plan-apply pipeline to reject unit-denom mismatches, add CI regression. ETA ~3 hours for rollout + 1h monitoring. Filing OPS ticket with repro and logs.
miguel (Infra): adding CI tests for unit conversion and an alert comparing rate_profiles.limit_unit vs enforcement.denom_unit.
jen.s (Support): created support case, cc'ed billing. We'll post postmortem and credit details here.
deploy-bot: deploy r/migration-unit-fix -> prod started at 12:58Z
lina (SRE): hotfix applied to prod at 13:04Z; verified normalization in 200 sample plan flips. Monitoring 30m.
jen.s (Support): marking resolved; will reopen if regression.
acme-apiops: still green at 13:18Z, no 429s in last 15m. leaving channel, watching PM link. :thumbsup:
